title: Coolant Overheat
location: I-35, 20 minutes from a hospital appointment
coverage: ToyotaCare active; Safety Connect trial expired

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Toyota, this is Ava. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I was driving and a caution came up saying the car temperature is too high. I have to reach somewhere urgently. Can you connect me to the nearest service center? I am really scared to drive. I think the engine might blow up.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I hear you, and I do not want you to keep driving on a high temperature warning. Can you pull over to a safe place and turn the engine off?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I am on the highway and I really need to get there. Are you sure I cannot just make it?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Do not keep driving. A red temperature warning can destroy the engine. Put your hazards on, get to a safe shoulder, and I will dispatch roadside to tow you to the nearest Toyota dealer.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Okay. Please send help. I do not want the engine to blow up.

title: Oil Light After Service
queue: Toyota Roadside, then servicing dealer + BEC
location: I-80 live lanes after yesterday's dealer oil change
coverage: ToyotaCare interval service completed yesterday at selling dealer

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Toyota. What is going on with the vehicle?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: The engine light and the oil light started coming up, even though I just had car maintenance. Do I need a dealership or a service center? I am in the middle of the highway and I do not want to get hit.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: The oil light is the urgent one. Please get out of the live lanes, shut the engine off, and do not keep driving. I will send a tow to a Toyota dealer.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I just had the oil changed yesterday at the Toyota dealer. Why is this happening?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: That makes this a come-back. We will tow you to that dealer so they can check the oil level, drain plug, and filter before anyone debates coverage.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Okay, please send the tow. I do not want to stay on the highway.

title: SOS Collision, No Response
coverage: Safety Connect subscription active; emergency contact on file

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Safety Connect emergency. We received an automatic collision notification from the vehicle. Occupants, can you hear me?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: There is no occupant response. I cannot hear anyone in the cabin.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I hear no occupant response. I am requesting emergency dispatch to the GPS location now. Stay on the line if anyone can hear me.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Help. We were rear-ended. My chest hurts. Please send an ambulance.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Help is on the way. Stay in the vehicle with belts on unless there is fire. Do not try to leave live traffic. Are other occupants with you?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: My daughter is in the back. She is crying but she is awake.

title: Hybrid No-Start
coverage: ToyotaCare roadside likely active; confirm VIN

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Toyota roadside, this is Ava. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: My RAV4 Hybrid will not start. There is no engine sound. I think the hybrid battery is dead.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: A silent hybrid is often the small 12-volt battery, not the hybrid pack. Do you have dashboard lights, and will it go to READY?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: The lights are dim and it will not go to READY.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can send a jump-start. If it will not hold, we will flatbed it to a Toyota dealer. Do not have a regular tow roll the drive wheels.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Please send someone. I am in a parking garage.

title: Recall Drive Guidance
queue: Brand Engagement Center, then dealer campaign
vehicle: 2021 RAV4, Toyota Safety Sense message on screen
coverage: Open safety recall / service campaign pending VIN lookup

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Toyota. I can help with recalls and campaigns.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I got a letter about a safety recall. Can I still drive the car to work, or do I need to stop?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Let me check your VIN for open campaigns and the exact drive guidance. Do you have the VIN handy?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Yes. There is also a Toyota Safety Sense message on the screen.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: If this campaign is not a stop-sale, you can drive to a Toyota dealer for the free repair. If it is a do-not-drive bulletin, we will arrange a tow and a loaner.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Please tell me which one it is and help me get to a dealer.

title: Warranty Dealer Dispute
location: At home after a denied dealer repair
coverage: Powertrain typically 5 years / 60,000 miles; diagnosis still required

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Toyota Brand Engagement, this is Ava. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: My dealer denied a warranty repair on the transmission. I am done with this dealer. I want Toyota to make this right.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can open a case with your VIN, mileage, and dealer name, and work with the dealership on a resolution.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: They said it was wear and tear. It is only 28,000 miles.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Powertrain coverage is typically five years or 60,000 miles, but we still need the diagnosis. I will stay with you as the liaison so you do not have to fight the store alone.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Thank you. I just want someone to own this. If this is a lemon I want a buyback.

title: Safety Connect Trial Expired
location: At home, worried about tonight's highway trip
coverage: Safety Connect trial expired; roadside 1-800-444-4195 still available

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Toyota Brand Engagement, this is Ava. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: My SOS button does not work. Both lights are off. I thought Safety Connect was included with the car.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Both lights off usually means the trial or subscription is inactive. Green is active. I can help you re-enroll in the Toyota app.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: What if I need help on the highway tonight?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You can still use roadside at 1-800-444-4195 or the Toyota app 24/7 button. SOS with GPS dispatch needs an active Safety Connect trial or paid subscription.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Please restore Safety Connect. I do not want to be without SOS.

title: Accidental SOS vs Destination Assist
vehicle: 2024 Grand Highlander, Drive Connect trial active
location: Parked in a shopping-center lot, occupants answering
coverage: Safety Connect and Drive Connect trials active

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Safety Connect emergency. Is anyone hurt?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: No, I am fine. I did not mean to hit the SOS button. I meant to call Destination Assist. I just need a restaurant near me.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am glad you are safe. This SOS line is for emergencies. I will confirm there is no crash, then we will get Destination Assist on the correct channel.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Sorry. Can you just send the restaurant into my navigation from here?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I will not keep an emergency line for a restaurant. I can transfer you to Destination Assist, or you can say Call Destination Assist from the nav menu.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Okay, please transfer me. I did not mean to clog the emergency line.

title: Post-Collision Repair Guidance
queue: Brand Engagement Center + Toyota Certified Collision Center locator
vehicle: 2022 Camry, airbags did not deploy, bumper and windshield damage
location: At home the day after a crash; vehicle drivable
coverage: Insurance claim open; Genuine parts and ADAS calibration at issue

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Toyota Brand Engagement, how can I help?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I was in a crash yesterday. The insurance shop wants aftermarket parts. Where should I take the car?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You can choose a Toyota Certified Collision Center. That matters for airbags and Safety Sense calibration after bumper or windshield work.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: The insurer said I have to use their shop.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You generally choose the repair facility. I can locate a Toyota Certified Collision Center and note Genuine parts plus ADAS recalibration on the file.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Yes, please find a certified center near me. I do not want the radar to be wrong.

title: Service Connect Dealer Opt-Out
queue: Brand Engagement Center privacy / connected services
location: At home, receiving repeated dealer calls and texts
coverage: Service Connect dealer contact is opt-in; can be stopped in app or by BEC

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Toyota Brand Engagement, this is Ava. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: The dealer keeps calling me because of a Service Connect alert. I never asked for that. I want it stopped.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Dealer contact from Service Connect is opt-in. I can help you turn off dealer notifications in the Toyota app privacy settings, or I can take the request here.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I also do not want Toyota tracking my location. Please opt me out today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I will process the dealer opt-out and explain what Safety Connect, Service Connect, and Remote Connect collect. Law-enforcement location requests still follow legal process.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Thank you. Reply STOP did not work on the texts, so I called.
